name: 簡潔なフィードバック設定入口
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0008 簡潔なフィードバック設定入口.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE minimal feedback settings entry, original region16,566,358,77 normalized. Exact only Japanese text: small heading 一般 above; action ご意見・ご要望を送信 in the single row. Meiryo REGULAR weight400, heading12/16, action14/24, tracking0. Do not make labels bold. Keep left-aligned action and compact logical358px width/44px row, as original and saved mock. Adapt original blue feedback action to a forest-green gradient rounded action row with legible white label and gentle edge light, restrained downward shadow. Heading on pure-white canvas above; no extra enclosing card. Original contains no leading icon or chevron, so add none. No settings list, completion action, helper copy, phone chrome or extra features. Render readable wide around1536x600 with restrained pure-white margins, enlarged uniformly.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Adapt the action affordance to official forest-green gradient row/white label; no additional accent or icon because none exists in source.
reviewNotes: 原版全体/crop/mockを目視。青いfeedback affordanceを森緑gradientへ適応。生成後に一般とご意見・ご要望を送信の正確な2文字列、左整列、余計なicon/chevronなし、白面と単一操作行を確認。操作・font同一性・native編集・所有者承認未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
